select t.seq, t.up_seq as upSeq, /* Alias for DTO mapping if needed, though mapUnderscoreToCamelCase should handle it */ t.title /* children will be populated by service layer logic */ from ( with recursive viewData(INDEX_LEVEL,SEQ,UP_SEQ,TITLE) as ( select 1 as INDEX_LEVEL ,seq as SEQ ,up_seq as UP_SEQ ,title as TITLE from document_base where 1=1 and up_seq = 0 union all select INDEX_LEVEL + 1 as INDEX_LEVEL ,t1.seq as SEQ ,t1.up_seq as UP_SEQ ,t1.title as TITLE from document_base t1, viewData t2 where 1=1 and t1.up_seq = t2.seq ) select * from viewData ) t where 1=1
and t.up_seq = 0 and t.index_level = 1
and t.up_seq = #{seq}::numeric and t.index_level = 2
and t.up_seq = #{seq}::numeric and t.index_level = 3
order by t.seq asc

select db.seq, db.up_seq as upSeq, db.title, db.contents, db.reg_dttm as regDttm, db.mod_dttm as modDttm, db.file_master_seq as fileMasterSeq from document_base db
where 1=1
and db.up_seq in (select seq from viewdata where index_level = 2 and up_seq = #{menu1}::numeric) and db.title is not null
and db.seq in (select seq from viewdata where index_level = 3 and up_seq = #{menu2}::numeric) and db.title is not null
and db.seq = (select seq from viewdata where index_level = 3 and seq = #{menu3}::numeric) and db.title is not null
limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from document_base where 1=1 and seq = #{seq}
